description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch StepExecutionListener that copies specified key-value pairs from the Job's execution context to the Step's execution context before the step begins. It utilizes Lombok for logging and Apache Commons Lang3 for Boolean checks.

classes.name: JobExecutionContextCopyListener
classes.description: A listener class for Spring Batch steps that copies specific entries from the job execution context to the step execution context prior to step execution.

methods.name: JobExecutionContextCopyListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list of keys to be copied from job to step execution context.

methods.name: beforeStep
methods.description: Method invoked before a step executes; copies specified context entries from the job to the step context if they are not already present in the step context.
